problems: The card names large red wheels, but the three driver pairs (r 0.13) are smaller than the boiler and sit mostly hidden behind the cylinders and running board. They read as small. Changed to the classic western layout: two large driver pairs (r 0.16) and a four-wheel leading truck. Everything above the frame is raised 0.04 so the drivers clear the running board.

The pilot is a big flat red slab, the largest red shape on the card. It looks like a bulldozer blade and pulls the red away from the wheels. Made it a smaller dark-gray wedge whose top meets the buffer beam's underside.
The pony axle sat below the frame's bottom edge, so the front wheels were attached to nothing. Added a leading-truck frame that the truck axles pass through.
The tender axles sat below the tender frame and barely touched it. Made the tender frame deeper so the axles pass through it.
The boiler handrails floated about 0.04 off the boiler with no supports. Added stanchions.
Several thin parts were under about 1/40 of the object's height (handrails 0.013, main rod 0.016, piston rod 0.013). Made them thicker.
The main rod ran from the crosshead to the middle driver, but it belongs on the rear driver of a 4-4-0. It now runs to the rear driver's crank pin, and the side rod couples the two drivers.
